title: 第一卷 第21章 王铁头
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
码头上的风，带着一股子腥咸和腐烂的味道。

    几百号苦力挤在三号仓库前，汗臭味、脚臭味混在一起，熏得人脑仁疼。

    没人说话，所有人都将目光落在站在前面木箱子上的陆川身上。

    刚才陆川那番话掷地有声，可回应他的，只有死一样的寂静。

    风卷起地上的烂菜叶，打着旋儿。

    陆川双手插兜，站在人群前头，目光扫过这一张张黝黑、麻木、畏缩的脸。

    眼神很冷。

    他在等，等一个敢出头的人。

    一秒。

    两秒。

    十秒过去了。

    人群里有人想往前挤，脚刚迈出去半步，被旁边人死死拽住衣角，摇了摇头。

    那眼神里的意思很明显：别找死。

    漕运商会那是多大的势力？那是吃人不吐骨头的阎王殿。

    刚才陆川是猛，打跑了刘三那一帮狗腿子。

    可刘三只是个跑腿的，漕运商会真要动怒，那是能调动军队的主儿。

    谁当这个出头鸟，谁就是全家的催命符。

    陆川眼中的冷意更甚。

    这就是底层。

    不是他们不想活得好，是跪久了膝盖生根了，站不起来。

    “没人吗？”

    陆川开口了，声音不大，却像冰块砸在铁板上，“刚才骂赵扒皮的时候，嗓门不是挺大吗？”

    “现在有人给你们机会翻身，一个个都成哑巴了？”

    人群骚动了一下，依旧没人敢接茬。

    陆川有些失望。

    他视线在人群中逡巡，最后定格在一个角落。

    那里站着个汉子。

    二十六七岁年纪，皮肤黝黑，个头不高，但肩膀极宽，像是个实心的铁墩子。

    他缩在人堆里，尽量降低存在感，可那一身鼓胀的肌肉把破烂的麻布衫撑得满满当当。

    “王大刚。”

    陆川突然点名。

    那汉子浑身一僵猛地抬头，眼神慌乱。

    “出来！”

    陆川招了招手。

    周围的人群自动分开一条道，几百双眼睛齐刷刷地盯着那个叫王大刚的汉子，有同情，有幸灾乐祸，也有期待。

    王大刚咽了口唾沫，喉结上下滚动。

    他想退，可身后全是人，退无可退。

    他只能硬着头皮，低着头，像头笨拙的狗熊，一步一挪地蹭了出来。

    “陆......陆爷。”

    王大刚站在陆川面前，低着头，不敢看陆川的眼睛，两只大手不安地搓着裤缝，“您......您叫我？”

    “我之前听别人说你练过铁头功？”
content_en:
The wind on the pier carried a fishy, ​​salty and rotten smell.

    Hundreds of coolies were crowded in front of Warehouse No. 3, and the smell of sweat and feet mixed together to make people's brains ache.

    No one spoke, and everyone focused their attention on Lu Chuan, who was standing on the wooden box in front.

    Lu Chuan's words just now were loud and clear, but in response to him, there was only deathly silence.

    The wind picked up the rotten vegetable leaves on the ground and swirled them.

    Lu Chuan stood in front of the crowd with his hands in his pockets, scanning the dark, numb, and shrinking faces.

    His eyes were cold.

    He is waiting for someone who dares to come forward.

    One second.

    Two seconds.

    Ten seconds passed.

    Someone in the crowd wanted to push forward, but as soon as he took half a step, the person next to him grabbed him tightly by the corner of his clothes and shook his head.

    The meaning in that look was clear: Don't seek death.

    How powerful is the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce? That is the Palace of Hell that eats people without spitting out their bones.

    Lu Chuan was so fierce just now that he beat away Liu San's gang of thugs.

    But Liu San is just an errand boy. If the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce is really angry, he is the master who can mobilize the army.

    Whoever takes the lead will be the life-warning talisman for the whole family.

    The coldness in Lu Chuan's eyes was even worse.

    This is the bottom layer.

    It’s not that they don’t want to live a good life, it’s that their knees have taken root after kneeling for a long time and they can’t stand up.

    "No one?"

    Lu Chuan spoke, his voice not loud, but like ice hitting an iron plate, "When you scolded Zhao Papi just now, wasn't his voice quite loud?"

    "Now someone gives you a chance to turn over, and you are all mute?"

    There was a commotion in the crowd, but still no one dared to take action.

    Lu Chuan was a little disappointed.

    His eyes wandered among the crowd, and finally settled on a corner.

    There was a man standing there.

    He is twenty-six or seventeen years old, with dark skin and short height, but his shoulders are extremely broad, like a solid iron pillar.

    He huddled in the crowd, trying to reduce his presence as much as possible, but the bulging muscles filled his tattered linen shirt.

    "Wang Dagang."

    Lu Chuan suddenly called his name.

    The man froze and raised his head suddenly, his eyes panicked.

    "Come out!"

    Lu Chuan waved.

    The surrounding crowd automatically separated into a lane, and hundreds of pairs of eyes stared at the man named Wang Dagang with sympathy, gloating, and expectation.

    Wang Dagang swallowed, his Adam's apple rolling up and down.

    He wanted to retreat, but there were people behind him and there was no way to retreat.

    He could only bite the bullet, lower his head, and move out step by step like a clumsy bear.

    "Lu...Master Lu."

    Wang Dagang stood in front of Lu Chuan, his head lowered, not daring to look into Lu Chuan's eyes, and his two big hands rubbed the seam of his trousers uneasily, "You...you called me?"

    "I heard someone say before that you practiced Tietou Kung Fu?"
